key_moments.title: Corporate Reallocation to Diagnostics
key_moments.blurb: Management clarified that the 20 basis point guidance increase at the midpoint for the Diagnostics segment was a reallocation of anticipated deal revenue from Corporate due to increased closure confidence, rather than a material shift in underlying operational trends.

key_moments.title: Regulatory and PAMA Visibility
key_moments.blurb: CEO Adam Schechter noted that data submissions for PAMA are due imminently, with industry visibility expected by October. The company is actively pushing for the alternative RESULTS Act legislative package while maintaining a backup strategy to delay PAMA cuts.

at_a_glance.headline: Segment Revenue and Bookings Accelerate
at_a_glance.detail: The Diagnostics Laboratories segment grew 5.5% to $2.90 billion, while the Biopharma Laboratory Services segment rose 6.5% to $836.2 million alongside a healthy quarterly book-to-bill ratio of 1.14.

at_a_glance.headline: Full-Year 2026 Guidance Upgraded
at_a_glance.detail: Management raised its full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to a range of $18.10 to $18.55 and enterprise revenue growth expectations to 5.4% to 6.3%, fueled by strong operational performance.

at_a_glance.headline: Operating Margin Expansion Achieved
at_a_glance.detail: Labcorp marked its fifth consecutive quarter of operating margin expansion, with adjusted operating margins increasing 70 basis points year-over-year to 15.8% due to operational efficiencies.

at_a_glance.headline: Capital Return Authorization Boosted
at_a_glance.detail: Demonstrating confidence in its cash generation and financial health, the board approved a $1.0 billion increase to its share repurchase program, pushing total remaining authorization to $1.4 billion.

CERT.summary: Certara reported Q2 2026 total revenue of $93.3M, missing the estimated $98.1M and representing modest 1% YoY growth. Software revenue rose 4% to $48.8M, representing 53% of the business, while services revenue declined 3% to $44.5M following the Regulatory and Medical Writing business carve-out.

key_moments.title: Revenue and EPS Miss Market Estimates
key_moments.blurb: Certara's Q2 2026 revenue of $93.3M and adjusted EPS of $0.08 came in below analyst expectations of $98.1M and $0.091. This softer financial showing was heavily impacted by the divestiture of its Regulatory and Medical Writing business, which caused a 3% decline in services segment revenue.

key_moments.title: Full-Year Margin and EPS Guidance Cut
key_moments.blurb: Management lowered its 2026 adjusted EBITDA margin guidance midpoint by 100 basis points to 29%–31% and reduced full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $0.31–$0.36. While the business unit underlying trends remain intact, the cuts reflect lingering unallocated infrastructure overhead following the May asset sale.

key_moments.title: Strategic Commercial Transformation and New Leadership
key_moments.blurb: Investors will be pleased by a 27% YoY pipeline expansion following a pivot back to specialist, scientist-led commercial teams. The operational course correction is being solidified by the appointment of Julien Perrier as Chief Commercial Officer to aggressively monetize cloud-based pharmacometrics and international markets.

key_moments.title: Increased Cost Savings Framework
key_moments.blurb: To defend margins against structural headwinds, Certara boosted its annualized run-rate cost savings target to $13 million, up from the previously outlined $10 million plan. The enhanced savings will be driven by the 5% reduction in force implemented at the start of Q3.

at_a_glance.headline: Certara Misses Financial Estimates Widely
at_a_glance.detail: Certara reported a top-line miss with revenue of $93,271,000 against expectations of $98,079,000, while reported adjusted EPS fell significantly short at -$0.36 compared to the estimated $0.091.

at_a_glance.headline: Software Bookings Drive Segment Divergence
at_a_glance.detail: Software bookings increased 9% year-over-year to $50.7 million, outperforming services bookings which fell 6% due to go-to-market adjustments and past divestitures.

at_a_glance.headline: Management Adjusts Margin Guidance Downward
at_a_glance.detail: The company adjusted its full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA margin guidance downward to a range of 29% to 31% to solely reflect stranded infrastructure costs from the divestiture of its regulatory business.

at_a_glance.headline: Strategic Focus Shifts Toward AI
at_a_glance.detail: Certara highlighted growing AI-driven productivity enhancements, revealing that up to 85% of its new software code is now AI-assisted, boosting engineer development rates by 65% year-over-year.

at_a_glance.headline: Revenue Miss Prompts Market Selloff
at_a_glance.detail: Following the earnings release, investor disappointment over the performance and ongoing structural transition triggered a sharp market reaction, causing the stock to plunge over 16% in premarket trading.
at_a_glance.summary: Certara reported Q2 2026 revenue of $93.3M, up 1% year-over-year, missing the estimated $98.1M. Software revenue grew 4% to $48.8M, while services fell 3% to $44.5M. Adjusted diluted EPS was $0.08, down from the $0.091 estimate. Management reaffirmed full-year revenue growth guidance of 0% to 4%.

key_moments.title: Q2 Financial Miss
key_moments.blurb: Certara missed Q2 2026 market expectations on both top and bottom lines, reporting revenue of $93.27M against the estimated $98.08M, and adjusted EPS of $0.08 versus the $0.091 estimate. This performance reflects ongoing softness in services bookings, which declined 6% year-over-year.

key_moments.title: EBITDA Margin Guidance Softening
key_moments.blurb: Management lowered its full-year adjusted EBITDA margin guidance range to 29% to 31%, down from the 30% to 32% expected in May. Investors may be disappointed by the near-term margin contraction, though management attributed it strictly to stranded infrastructure costs stemming from the recent divestiture.

key_moments.title: NVIDIA Partnership and AI Integration
key_moments.blurb: Certara's newly announced technology partnership with NVIDIA allows frontier AI agents to interface directly with Certara's life sciences software platform. This strategic move aims to accelerate drug discovery workflows and signal a deeper technology-partnering role within the biopharma ecosystem.

key_moments.title: Services Commercial Model Overhaul
key_moments.blurb: CEO Jon Resnick rejected the company's previous generalist commercial model implemented in 2024, shifting instead toward expert-led scientific engagements. This commercial pivot has rejuvenated service pipeline creation, which grew 27% year-over-year exiting the quarter, pointing to an eventual growth inflection.

at_a_glance.headline: Certara Misses Top and Bottom Lines
at_a_glance.detail: Certara reported a reported adjusted EPS of -$0.36, missing the estimated adjusted EPS of $0.091, while quarterly revenue came in at $93,271,000, falling short of the estimated $98,079,000.

at_a_glance.headline: Software Resilience Outpaces Services Weakness
at_a_glance.detail: Software segment revenue increased 4% year-over-year to $48.8 million with bookings up 9%, whereas services segment revenue decreased 3% to $44.5 million with bookings declining 6% due to post-divestiture transitions.

at_a_glance.headline: Management Lowers Full-Year Guidance Range
at_a_glance.detail: Certara downwardly revised its full-year 2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance to a range of $0.31 to $0.36, down from the previous outlook of $0.35 to $0.41, primarily to reflect the impacts of its recent regulatory business divestiture.

at_a_glance.headline: Earnings Miss Triggers Stock Selloff
at_a_glance.detail: The combination of missing Wall Street estimates and reduced guidance caused Certara's stock to plummet over 16% in premarket trading immediately following the announcement.

at_a_glance.headline: Strategic Expansion in Artificial Intelligence
at_a_glance.detail: Certara highlighted a new partnership with NVIDIA to integrate frontier AI capabilities and the BioNeMo Agent Toolkit into its biosimulation software to expand use cases and drug development efficiency.
